nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=65 beats='Priya and her little brother Maya finish sledding down the snowy hill. They feel tired and happy but very cold. Priya looks around to gather their things. Where is Maya's left boot?'>>

choices.label: Look for the boot right now

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=60 beats='Priya walks back along the snowy sled run, looking carefully. Her eyes follow the tracks from their sleds. The snow sparkles in white light. She needs to find the boot before dark comes.'>>

<<FILL role=transition words=58 beats='Priya runs back to where Mom is waiting with the car. She tells Mom about the lost boot. Mom listens and nods. They walk back to the sled run together, searching the white snow.'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='At the sled run, Priya looks at three places where the boot might be: the hill's top where they started, the middle slope where they tumbled, and the bottom near the big trees. Each looks different in snow.'>>

choices.label: Start at the top of the hill
Search the trees at the bottom

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='At the top of the hill, the snow is smooth and white. Priya looks everywhere for the boot. She sees tracks from their sleds going down. The air is cold. She shivers and keeps looking carefully.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=62 beats='In the middle section, Priya sees where they tumbled off their sleds. Snow and ice are everywhere. She walks slowly, looking left and right. The boot could be buried under fresh snow by now.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='The trees at the bottom cast dark shadows on the snow. It is colder there. Priya looks around the tree trunks carefully. Her brother's boot might have slid all the way down here. She looks hard.'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=72 beats='Priya is searching along the sled path. She sees her friend Tommy coming down the hill with his sled. Tommy waves and sees Priya looking for something. He can help her search or she might find it faster alone.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Tommy stops his sled and listens. He thinks searching together is fun. They split up and search different areas. Tommy looks by the snow wall while Priya checks the middle path. Two pairs of eyes are better.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=64 beats='Priya tells Tommy she will look by herself. She watches Tommy sled down again. Now Priya walks alone through the snow. She must be very careful and look at everything. Time is passing quickly.'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Priya is looking hard but snow covers a lot. She wonders if the boot flew off into deep powder or slid down quickly to a different spot. Mom is waiting. Priya feels worried about time running out.'>>

choices.label: Go back and ask Mom for ideas

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=65 beats='Priya pushes into the deep snow along the slope. It is cold and hard to walk. She sees something dark peeking out from the white. Wait, she sees the boot edge under the snow. It is stuck between ice patches.'>>

choices.label: Try to pull the boot out

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=72 beats='Priya pulls and pulls. Her mittens are wet and slippery. The boot comes free with a soft pop. Snow falls around it. She holds the boot up. It is wet but found. Priya feels happy and tired. Mom comes.'>>

<<FILL role=transition words=58 beats='Priya walks back to Mom, feeling tired. Mom suggests they go back to where Priya and Maya first put their boots on. Maybe the boot fell off there. It is worth checking before dark comes.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=66 beats='At the starting place near the parking lot, Priya looks everywhere. The snow looks different here. There is a bench and some bushes. She checks under the bench, in the snow, around bushes with Mom.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=64 beats='In the thick bushes, snow has piled up deep. Priya reaches in carefully, pushing branches aside. Her hand touches something soft and warm, not the boot. A bird nest sits there with snow on it. She pulls back.'>>

<<FILL role=decision words=68 beats='Priya looks at the time. It is getting later. Mom says they have only a little time before they need to go home. Priya feels rushed. Should she search one more spot or give up for today?'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Priya thinks hard. She remembers snow had blown near the parking lot edge. She walks to that spot with Mom. In the white snow beside the parking line, she spots a dark shape. Is it the boot?'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=68 beats='Priya reaches the dark shape. It is the boot! It landed by the parking lot and got covered with drifted snow. She picks it up and shakes off the snow. The boot is cold but okay. She found it!'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=62 beats='Priya walks between areas of the hill. Mom follows with the other boot. The sun is getting lower. Snow crunches under their feet. Priya has not found the boot and feels sad and tired.'>>

choices.label: Ask a park ranger for help

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=66 beats='A park ranger is checking the path. Priya tells the ranger about the lost boot. The ranger smiles and says the lost-and-found has things from the hill. Maybe the boot is there! They go check together.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=64 beats='In the warming hut, there is a big box of lost things. Hats, scarves, and gloves pile up inside. The ranger helps Priya look. She moves things aside, searching and hoping. Near the bottom, she sees red.'>>

<<FILL role=climax words=66 beats='It is a red boot but not Maya's. Priya checks and it is a different size. Priya's heart sinks. The ranger says to check back tomorrow. Maybe someone will bring it in tonight. They leave the hut.'>>

<<FILL role=transition words=60 beats='Priya is very tired now. She has searched many places on the snowy hill. Her feet are cold and her face is frozen. She walked up and down many times. Mom says it is time to head back.'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=62 beats='On the way back, Priya walks past a small shack where people store snow gear. The door is open a little bit. Inside, she can barely see shapes in the dark. Could the boot be in there?'>>

<<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Inside the shack, snow has drifted everywhere. Priya sees old sleds, broken skis, and boxes. The boot is not here. But on the floor next to the door, she sees a small dark boot. She picks it up carefully.'>>

choices.label: Check if it is the right boot

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Yes, it is Maya's boot! It has the pink laces Priya's mom sewed in. Priya holds it tight. She found it at last! The boot must have been kicked inside when they sledded. Priya feels relief and joy.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=72 beats='Priya walks into the house with the wet boot. Mom makes hot cocoa while the boot dries by the heater. Priya tells Maya the whole story. Maya laughs and thanks Priya for never giving up. They drink cocoa together. Priya feels proud.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='At home, Priya sets the boot by the door to dry. Her brother Maya comes home from his friend's house. When he sees his boot, he is so happy! Priya tells him how she searched everywhere. He gives her a hug and thanks her. They laugh together.'>>

ending.title: Boot Found by the Parking Lot

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Priya and Mom drive home. At home, Mom says not to worry. Tomorrow, someone might turn in the boot. Or they can look again. Priya feels sad that she did not find it. But Mom says Priya tried her very best. Sometimes things take time.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=66 beats='Priya is tired and sad. She did not find Maya's boot on the snowy hill. Walking back to the car, she feels like she let her brother down. Mom says she tried hard. Maybe the boot will turn up when the snow melts in spring. Priya hopes so.'>>

ending.title: The Boot Stays Lost in the Snow

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=64 beats='Priya walks away from the shack without looking inside. At home, she tells Maya that she could not find the boot. Maya says it is okay and gets another boot from the closet. Priya feels a little regret about not checking the shack.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=68 beats='Priya gives up the search as the sun gets lower. At home, she tells Maya they could not find the boot today. But that night, their neighbor stops by. He found a boot in his yard! The wind had blown it there. Priya's search was not wasted.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=72 beats='Priya rushes home with the boot. She bursts through the door and shows Mom. Then she finds Maya and tells the whole adventure of finding it in the shack. Maya is amazed. That night, Priya dreams of snowy slopes and happy endings. She is a hero.'>>

ending.title: Boot Found in the Old Shack
